How do you read Sthana Bala in practice?

Long image

A

Answer

Treat Sthana Bala as lifetime space strength: score the seven grahas in Virupas, then time results with the current or next Mahadasha lord.

  1. Sthana stays fixed for life; Kala and dasha change what fires when.1
  2. On Vedaansh, use componentShash.sthana (Virupas); divide by 60 for Rupas.2
  3. Soft band: about 100 baseline, 135–145+ across all seven = above-average living space; Saturn is fine near 110–120.1
  4. Classical worksheet floor on Vedaansh is 165 Virupas for the Sthana component percent.3

Applies toSthana Bala Part 1lecture methodVedaansh units

1

What is Sthana Bala?

Sthana Bala is positional strength: dignity, vargas, odd/even signs, kendra house, and drekkana. It does not use Rahu or Ketu as scored grahas; read them via dispositor or house lord.1

Two rulers, one chart

Lecture bands (~100, 135–145) are practice heuristics for life quality and dasha timing. Vedaansh also shows Sthana as % of 165 Virupas (Parashara-style component floor). Compare planets inside one chart first; do not mix soft and classical rulers blindly.

2

How is the score built?

Diagram structure
  • Uccha Bala uccha
  • Saptavargaja sapta
  • Ojhayugma oja
  • Kendradi ken
  • Drekkana dre
  • ken → dre
  • oja → ken
  • sapta → oja
  • uccha → sapta
  1. Uccha Bala ↗

    Distance from debilitation point; max 60 Virupas.

  2. Saptavargaja ↗

    Dignity in D1 D2 D3 D7 D9 D12 D30 (friends, own, MT).

  3. Ojhayugma ↗

    Odd/even Rashi and Navamsa fit for male vs female grahas.

  4. Kendradi ↗

    Kendra 60, panaphara 30, apoklima 15.

  5. Drekkana ↗

    First/middle/last 10° match by graha class; up to 15.

3

How do you analyse a chart?

Diagram structure
  • Open Shadbala tab open
  • Read seven Virupa rows seven
  • Grade soft vs classical band
  • Pick current or next MD lord dasha
  • Match topic to that lord topic
  • Apply planet-domain remedies remedy
  • band → dasha
  • dasha → topic
  • open → seven
  • seven → band
  • topic → remedy
  1. Open Shadbala tab ↗

    Classic view shows Virupa breakdown and Sthana % of 165.

  2. Read seven Virupa rows ↗

    Note dips below ~100 and peaks above ~150.

  3. Grade soft vs classical ↗

    Soft: 135–145+ all seven. Classical: ratio vs 165.

  4. Pick current or next MD lord ↗

    Prefer the upcoming Mahadasha when asking about selection or shift.

  5. Match topic to that lord ↗

    Job, house, marriage, child destiny — use that planet’s Sthana.

  6. Apply planet-domain remedies ↗

    Space acts that match the weak graha’s karakatwa.

Capacity, not guarantee

High Sthana is capacity for good space and status, not automatic yoga fruit. Always pair with house ownership, aspects, and dasha lords. Conscious remedies support living the graha’s domain; they do not rewrite natal math.
